svg.title: Issue 3 — Page 1 — Panel 4: MW OTS Cribbage's shoulder, Theodore at his bench in BG
svg.desc: MW 35mm eye level OTS Cribbage's right shoulder. Cribbage's hands prominent in foreground adjusting a clock escapement with fine steel tools. Workbench: tools in leather rolls, clock mechanisms on felt pads, magnifying lamp, brass components in compartments. Beyond him in dimmer back corner, Theodore at his smaller bench studying the disassembled watch movement, one hand hovering. Warm amber gaslight on main bench richly, Theodore's corner dimmer but warm reflected light. Painterly oil texture, the gap between master and apprentice.
svg.text: And stay away from the Perrault —
